caption: The drawing depicts a large, dark-colored, curved door handle or knocker, centrally positioned on a light, beige background that has a rectangular border. The handle attaches at both ends to decorative, shield-shaped plates, each fastened by three visible round-headed screws or rivets. The upper plate has a protruding knob or striking piece. To the lower left of the main object, there are two smaller technical drawings: one shows a front view of the complete hardware with both plates and the handle, and the other shows a side profile of the handle, highlighting its curvature. Above these technical drawings is a small scale, labeled "INCHES" and marked from 0 to 3. In the upper right corner of the image, the name "J. Stahloff" is inscribed. The entire artwork is rendered in shades of gray and black pencil or ink, with shading used to suggest the metallic nature and three-dimensionality of the object.
title: Door Handle with Thumb Press
